assertions.name: eta_quotient_lands_on_minus_10
assertions.source: |(η(τ₀)/η(5τ₀))⁶ + 10| at the 6-d.p. BDH22 τ₀; residual is τ₀-truncation-limited (~2e-5 observed).

description: Γ₀(5) hauptmodul gate t₅(τ₀) = −10 for Bring's modulus (uploaded-papers audit idea A2). Exact: t = −10 is a root of (t²+250t+3125)³ + (121945/32)t⁵ (sympy Rational; equivalently 32·(…)³ + 121945·t⁵ = 0 over ℤ), with Fricke companion 5³/(−10) = −25/2 = j(5τ₀). Numeric: the η-quotient (η(τ₀)/η(5τ₀))⁶ at BDH22's 6-d.p. τ₀ = −0.5+0.186676i lands on −10 to the τ₀-truncation scale. Lean arithmetic lock: QOU/Archimedean/BringHauptmodulGate.lean. Gate framing: any q₀ ↦ τ dictionary is physical only through Γ₀(5)-invariants (RR92 Thm 1) and must land on the class t₅ = −10 — discrete pass/fail, no precision search. Audit-only; nothing wired.
caveats: tau0 itself is transcendental (Schneider); only its Γ₀(5)-invariants (t₅ = −10, the j-pair) are exact. The numeric leg is truncation-limited by the 6-d.p. published tau0, not by compute precision.
